name: Check Screen Recording Permission
command:
#!/bin/bash
set -u
MEETINGS_DB="$PAPR_HOME/Jobs/40407339-ca0b-4650-a009-426201025e81/data/data.db"
RECORDER="$PAPR_HOME/Jobs/095b6dbf-6096-433c-83d9-e7a66b8e459b/recorder"
if [ ! -f "$MEETINGS_DB" ]; then echo "ERROR: meetings DB not found at $MEETINGS_DB"; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -x "$RECORDER" ]; then echo "ERROR: recorder binary not found at $RECORDER"; exit 1; fi
RESULT=$("$RECORDER" --check-permission 2>&1)
echo "$RESULT"
sqlite3 "$MEETINGS_DB" "DELETE FROM permission_checks; INSERT INTO permission_checks (check_time, result) VALUES (datetime('now'), '$RESULT');"
echo "Written to DB: $RESULT"
